stage: DP0-A Phase 1 - request payload inventory (current production request)

request_properties.thinking_setting: ABSENT from payload - neither explicitly enabled nor explicitly disabled; effective behavior depends on provider default (to be determined)
request_properties.user_prompt_characters: recorded per probe (contains the frozen essay and calibration payload; full content never committed)

user_payload_structure_v071.metrics: list[name,value] selected for the diagnosis signal source metrics
user_payload_structure_v071.learner_model_context: screened learner profile (targets, trajectories, history, sufficiency, limitations)
user_payload_structure_v071.learner_history: screened history evidence by allowed ids
user_payload_structure_v071.revision_snapshot: only when a linked revision exists

system_prompt_rules_relevant_to_output: Return exactly one JSON object matching required_schema and no markdown
Zero or one priority is valid; never pad to two
Every evidence_quote must be one contiguous character-for-character substring of submission.essay_text
Exercises may target current selected priorities only and must obey confidence limits
State uncertainty and prototype limitations plainly

correction_prompt_properties.structure: original messages + one user correction message
correction_prompt_properties.correction_message: Contains longitudinal repair instructions (when longitudinal fields failed), the instruction to return a corrected JSON object only, 'use only supplied ids', 'every evidence_quote must be copied character-for-character as one contiguous substring', and the validation failure text (first 800 chars)

observability_gap: The current adapter cannot answer the DP0-A questions A-F from its own records: it discards finish_reason, usage, response id, returned model, and raw content length before parsing.
